rules.budget_reversal: strict pairwise method-order inversions with both absolute QA margins >=0.01 (SciFact correctness margins >=1), then largest change in pairwise score margin, then ascending query ID; one query/dataset only if an inversion qualifies
rules.maximum_disagreement: largest per-query score spread; for SciFact @256 prefer FIXED-only correct and @1024 V1-only correct among equal spreads; then ascending query ID
rules.near_tie: spread <=0.01, max score >0, with token range >=10% budget or minimum pairwise underlying-sentence Jaccard <=0.5; smallest spread, largest allocation difference, highest max score, query ID; prefer unused eligible query; absent eligibility is explicitly flagged
rules.score: QA per-query F1; SciFact binary correctness, never per-query macro-F1
rules.selection_bias: up to 18 primary case slots plus 3 budget reversals; duplicate query/budget cases are disclosed and frequencies also use unique query/budget units
rules.v2_rescue: positive V2−V1 first, largest delta, then number of other methods beating V1, largest spread, query ID; prefer unused query among positive candidates; if none positive explicitly mark no positive rescue
